newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pan Australian cites gold anomalies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pan Australian cites gold anomalies.

text.p: Pan Australian Resources NL said on Monday it had defined two significant gold anomalies on its tenements in the Yilgarn Extension project in Western Australia.
"To find two anomalies at the beginning of an extensive programme is highly encouraging," Pan Australian's managing director, Gary Stafford, said in a statement.

"The programme, which has been designed to determine optimal sampling methods by testing different greenstone geological settings within the project area, is targeting over 30 high-magnetic structurally significant zones," he said.
The anomalies were defined in Target Zone T4 on the company's wholly-owned tenements.
The first anomaly is 1.4 km long by 500 metres wide. The second anomaly is over two km long by 300 metres wide, the company said.
Drilling to investigate the source of the anomalies will commence in February and March of next year, the company said.

Results are also pending fron a further three target zones and from the northern part of the first anomaly, Pan Australian said. Its shares closed 6-1/2 cents higher at A$0.335. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
